confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant meal, cappuccino and draft beer rest on aggregated cost-of-living figures for La Spezia (a Numbeo-derived snapshot dated around June 2026, plus a Dove e Quando average) and were converted from EUR at an approximate 1.10 USD per EUR. That rate is a cross-rate implied by a third-party page dated 18 Nov 2026 and was not checked against an official EUR source. No La Spezia-specific price for a cocktail or a restaurant glass of wine was found. The cocktail anchor is set at about 1.5 times the draft beer anchor and the wine glass at about 0.95 times it, which are judgement bases. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not based on any inspected listing or live booking page. FX: the 0.6720 rate for 18 Nov 2026 was reported in search results citing the RBA exchange rates page. I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, and no 19 Nov 2026 observation was found, so verify against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Italian Ligurian port city. Food anchors use La Spezia aggregates. Accommodation uses general knowledge of comparable Italian coastal cities in peak season, with a modest uplift for proximity to the Cinque Terre.
